body: Note that this lookup only handles `CLASS` datatype kind, while there are also `SCRIPT` and `NATIVE`. I'm not sure if `SCRIPT` is applicable here (if I remember correctly, we always use `CLASS` for the base type), but `NATIVE` is definitely not handled here. This means that users won't be able to use native methods as setters/getters. But this is probably rarely needed in practice.
